{{Quote|Great work, Officer. Follow me, I have something to show you.|The homestead owner, to Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="SW:BFN" />}}
A '''Human''' owned a homestead on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] countryside at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SW:BFN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Early during the invasion, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched an [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|attack]] on [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo civilians]] to quell any potential uprisings. The [[Human/Legends|Human's]] homestead was in the way of the advancing [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], was in the area at the same time.<ref name="SW:BFN" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Lieutenant Sykes used his [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeder]] to destroy the first wave of [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]], after which the Human ran out from their house to their [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. A second wave of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] pursued the individual's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], but Sykes drove them off. In gratitude, the individual asked the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to follow them. Leading Sykes to their nearby [[Farm/Legends|farm]], the homestead owner gave the pilot technology useful to the [[Naboo Resistance]]. The homestead owner subsequently hid in their [[Armor/Legends|armored]] barn.<ref name="SW:BFN" />
{{Endgame}}

The light-skinned owner was [[Clothing/Legends|wearing]] a [[Color/Legends|blue]] tunic with black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] during the encounter.<ref name="SW:BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The homestead owner appears in a side-quest in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. Saving them from attacking droids allows the player to find a vehicle upgrade and fulfill a bonus objective by picking up the upgrade. They use the same sprite as the other Human characters in the game.<ref name="SW:BFN" />
